# Read in the data

```{r}
d1 <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/",
                           "washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_pathogen_2026-09-16.rds")) %>%
  # final visit only
  filter(visit == 2) %>%
  #mutate(
    #pathogenf = pathogenf,
    #pathogenf = recode(
      #pathogenf,
      #"S. enterica typhi (HylE)" = "S. enterica typhi (HlyE)"
    #)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tr)) %>%
  # Indicatior for WSH and Nutrition interventions
  mutate(wsh = ifelse(tr %in% c("WSH","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0), 
         nutr = ifelse(tr %in% c("Nutrition","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0),
         wshf = ifelse(wsh==1,"WASH","No WASH"),
         nutrf = ifelse(nutr==1,"Nutrition","No Nutrition"),
         wshf = factor(wshf, levels=c("No WASH","WASH")),
         nutrf = factor(nutrf, levels=c("No Nutrition","Nutrition")))


```

# Secondary analysis

- Seroprevalence at visit 2 (~12 months). We will summarize seroprevalence similar to the primary analysis but using measurements collected from EED substudy children at visit 2. 


# Basic outcome summary at 12 months

## Table 1. Overall pathogen-level seroprevalence at 12 months

```{r}
prev_tbl <- d1 %>%
  group_by(pathogenf) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(seropos)), 
            total_seropos = sum(seropos, na.rm = T),
            prev = mean(seropos, na.rm = T), 
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prev = round(prev, 3)) 

prev_tbl %>%
  kable(caption = "Pathogen-level seroprevalence at 12-month visit",
        col.names = c("Pathogen", "N", "Sero Positive", "Prevalence")) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times")
```

## Table 2. Marginal and conditional pathogen-level seroprevalence at 12 months


# Estimate treatment effects

- Note: We do not control for block in the analysis. The EED substudy did not retain the pair-matching in the design, so there are many blocks without treatment contrasts in them. We cannot therefore include fixed effects for block.

```{r}
#| label: estimate marginal means and effects in visit 2
#-------------------------
# fit models
# order pathogens 
# by virus, bacteria, 
# protozoan, helminth
#-------------------------
pathogen_list <- levels(d1$pathogenf)

#-------------------------
# estimate marginal means
# and differences
# for visit 3
#-------------------------
marg_effects_v2 <- foreach(ii = 1:length(pathogen_list), .combine = rbind) %do% {
  di <- d1 %>%
    filter(pathogenf == pathogen_list[ii])
    # fit linear regression
    # For secondary analysis,	do not control for block in the analysis. 
    fiti <- glm(seropos ~ wshf + nutrf, data=di, family=gaussian(link="identity"))
    # estimate cluster-robust SEs
    fiti_vcovCL <- sandwich::vcovCL(fiti, cluster = di$clusterid)
    # estimate marginal means for each treatment margin, difference scale
    musi_wash <- emmeans(fiti, ~ wshf   , vcov = fiti_vcovCL)
    musi_wash <- regrid(musi_wash,type="response")
    musi_nutr <- emmeans(fiti, ~ nutrf  , vcov = fiti_vcovCL)
    musi_nutr <- regrid(musi_nutr,type="response")
    # estimate marginal contrasts
    diffi_wash <- pairs(musi_wash, simple = "each", reverse = TRUE)
    diffi_nutr <- pairs(musi_nutr, simple = "each", reverse = TRUE)
    # gather results
    res1 <- data.frame(musi_wash) %>% 
      rename(marginal_mean = wshf, se_mean = SE, df_mean = df)
    res2 <- data.frame(musi_nutr) %>% 
      rename(marginal_mean = nutrf,se_mean = SE, df_mean = df)
    res3 <- data.frame(diffi_wash) %>% mutate(marginal_mean = "WASH")
    res4 <- data.frame(diffi_nutr) %>% mutate(marginal_mean = "Nutrition")
    res5 <- left_join(res1,res3, join_by(marginal_mean))
    res6 <- left_join(res2,res4, join_by(marginal_mean))
    res  <- bind_rows(res5,res6) %>% mutate(pathogen = pathogen_list[ii])
    return(res)
    
}

#-------------------------
# separate out the marginal
# means from the contrasts
#-------------------------
marg_means_v2 <- marg_effects_v2 %>%
  mutate(visit = 2) %>%
  select(pathogen, visit, marginal_mean, emmean, se_mean, df_mean, min95=lower.CL, max95 = upper.CL)

marg_diff_v2 <- marg_effects_v2 %>%
  mutate(visit = 2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(contrast)) %>%
  select(pathogen, visit, contrast, estimate, se=SE, df, t_val = t.ratio, p_value = p.value) %>%
  mutate(min95 = estimate - 1.96*se, max95 = estimate + 1.96*se)

#------------------------------
# create formatted RD estimates
#------------------------------
marg_diff_ests <- marg_diff_v2 %>%
    mutate(
      rd = estimate*100,
      rd_print =  paste0(sprintf("%1.1f",estimate*100)," (",sprintf("%1.1f",min95*100),", ",sprintf("%1.1f",max95*100),")"  )
    )

```

## Table 3. Marginal seropositivity (mean and 95% CI) and marginal differences

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 1) Build mean (95% CI) strings and pivot wide
# -------------------------
means_wide <- marg_means_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen_list),
    mean_ci = paste0(
      sprintf("%.1f", 100*emmean), "% (",
      sprintf("%.1f", 100*min95), ", ",
      sprintf("%.1f", 100*max95), ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(pathogen, marginal_mean, mean_ci) %>%
  mutate(
    marginal_mean = recode(
      marginal_mean,
      "WASH" = "Combined WASH",
      "No WASH" = "No WASH",
      "Nutrition" = "Combined Nutrition",
      "No Nutrition" = "No Nutrition"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marginal_mean, values_from = mean_ci) %>%
  arrange(pathogen)

# -------------------------
# Build difference (95% CI) + p-value strings and pivot wide
# -------------------------
diff_wide <- marg_diff_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen_list),
    domain = case_when(
      str_detect(contrast, "WASH") ~ "WSH",
      str_detect(contrast, "Nutrition") ~ "Nutrition",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    diff_ci = paste0(
      sprintf("%.1f", 100*estimate), " (",
      sprintf("%.1f", 100*min95), ", ",
      sprintf("%.1f", 100*max95), ")"
    ),
    p_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", p_value)
  ) %>%
  select(pathogen, domain, diff_ci, p_fmt) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = domain,
    values_from = c(diff_ci, p_fmt),
    names_glue = "{domain}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  arrange(pathogen)

# -------------------------
# Combine into one final table
# -------------------------
tab_v2 <- means_wide %>%
  left_join(diff_wide, by = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen)) %>%
  select(
    pathogen,
    `No WASH`, `Combined WASH`, WSH_diff_ci, WSH_p_fmt,
    `No Nutrition`, `Combined Nutrition`, Nutrition_diff_ci, Nutrition_p_fmt
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `WSH diff (95% CI)` = WSH_diff_ci,
    `WSH p value` = WSH_p_fmt,
    `Nutrition diff (95% CI)` = Nutrition_diff_ci,
    `Nutrition p value` = Nutrition_p_fmt
  )

# -------------------------
# Print table
# -------------------------
tab_v2 %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l", rep("c", ncol(tab_v2) - 1)),
    caption = "Marginal seropositivity (mean and 95% CI) and marginal differences at 12 months"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(
    " " = 1,
    "WSH main effect (marginal)" = 4,
    "Nutrition main effect (marginal)" = 4
  )) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, border_right = TRUE) %>%  # after pathogen
  column_spec(5, border_right = TRUE) %>%               # after WSH block
  row_spec(seq(2, nrow(tab_v2), by = 2), background = "#f7f7f7") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "500px")

saveRDS(tab_v2, here("output", "washbb-marginal-effects-12m.rds"))
write_csv(tab_v2, here("output", "washbb-marginal-effects-12m.csv"))
```


# Permutation-based p-values

- Estimate 2-sided permutation P-values by permuting treatment assignments within matched blocks (10,006 replicates) and using the regression coefficients for WSH and Nutrition as test statistics. 
- We will additionally report P-values adjusted for multiple testing, controlling the false discovery rate using a Benjamini-Hochberg correction for the 12 comparisons.  

```{r}
#---------------------------
# permute treatment (no need to be within block here)
#---------------------------
set.seed(12345)
npermute <- 10006
# get the unique list of blocks/clusters/tx
cl_tx <- d1 %>%
  select(block,clusterid,tr) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(tx=as.character(tr))
# create permuted assignments, conditional on block
perm_mat <- matrix(nrow=nrow(cl_tx),ncol=npermute)
for(i in 1:npermute) {
  cl_txi <- cl_tx %>% mutate(txi = sample(tx,replace=FALSE))
  perm_mat[,i] <- cl_txi$txi
}

#---------------------------
# loop over pathogens and
# permuted randomizations
#---------------------------
# make a small dataset for the permutation loop
# to keep it lean
d_pathogen_perm <- d1 %>%
  filter(visit==2) %>%
  select(pathogenf,block,clusterid,seropos)

start_time <- Sys.time()
permute_dist <- foreach(pathi = pathogen_list, .combine=rbind ) %dopar% {
  di <- d_pathogen_perm %>% filter(pathogenf == pathi)
  
  foreach(permi = 1:npermute, .combine = rbind) %do% {
    dij <- di %>%
      left_join(data.frame(clusterid=cl_tx$clusterid,tr_perm=perm_mat[,permi]),join_by(clusterid))
    dij$wsh_perm  = ifelse(dij$tr_perm %in% c("WSH","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0)
    dij$nutr_perm = ifelse(dij$tr_perm %in% c("Nutrition","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0)
    #fiti <- lm(seropos ~ wsh_perm + nutr_perm + factor(block), data = dij)
    fiti <- lm(seropos ~ wsh_perm + nutr_perm , data = dij)
    coefs <- coef(fiti)
    res <- data.frame(pathogen=pathi,permute_n=permi,wash=coefs[2],nutr=coefs[3])
  }
}
end_time <- Sys.time()
cat("\nThe permutation test took:\n")
```

The permutation test took:
```{r}
difftime(end_time,start_time)
```


```{r}
#---------------------------
# join on observed values
#---------------------------
ests_obs <- marg_diff_ests %>%
  select(pathogen, contrast, estimate) %>%
  mutate(contrast2 = ifelse(contrast == "WASH - No WASH","wash","nutr")) %>%
  select(pathogen,contrast2,estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = pathogen, names_from = "contrast2", values_from = "estimate") %>%
  rename(wash_obs = wash, nutr_obs = nutr)

permute_dist2 <- permute_dist %>%
  left_join(ests_obs, join_by(pathogen))

#---------------------------
# estimate permutation p-values
#---------------------------
permute_dist3 <- permute_dist2 %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(p_wash = mean(abs(wash) >= abs(wash_obs),  na.rm = TRUE),
         p_nutr = mean(abs(nutr) >= abs(nutr_obs),  na.rm = TRUE)
         ) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen_list)) 


#---------------------------
# plot the permutation distributions
# WASH v No WASH
#---------------------------
p_annotation_df <- permute_dist3 %>%
  select(pathogen, p_wash, p_nutr) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>% slice(1) %>%
  mutate(
    p_wash_print = paste0("P = ",sprintf("%1.3f",p_wash)),
    p_nutr_print = paste0("P = ",sprintf("%1.3f",p_nutr)),
    x_print = 0, y_print = 700
  )
  
plot_permute_dists_wash <- ggplot(data = permute_dist3, aes(x = wash)) +
  facet_wrap(.~pathogen,ncol=3, scales = "free") + 
  geom_histogram(bins=50,alpha=0.5,color=NA) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = wash_obs), lty="dashed") +
  geom_text(data=p_annotation_df, aes(x=x_print,y=y_print,label = p_wash_print)) +
  labs(title = "Permutation P-values, effect of WASH", y="permutations",x="permutation null distribution (WASH - No WASH)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,800)) + 
  theme_minimal()

plot_permute_dists_wash

#---------------------------
# plot the permutation distributions
# Nutrition v No Nutrition
#---------------------------

plot_permute_dists_nutr <- ggplot(data = permute_dist3, aes(x = nutr)) +
  facet_wrap(.~pathogen,ncol=3, scales = "free") + 
  geom_histogram(bins=50,alpha=0.5,color=NA) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = nutr_obs), lty="dashed") +
  geom_text(data=p_annotation_df, aes(x=x_print,y=y_print,label = p_nutr_print)) +
  labs(title = "Permutation P-values, effect of Nutrition", y="permutations",x="permutation null distribution (Nutrition - No Nutrition)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,800)) +
```

# Calculate FDR adjusted p-values

- Apply Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all 12 pathogens for the WASH permutation p-values and separately across all 12 pathogens for the Nutrition permutation p-values.

```{r}
#---------------------------
# calculate FDR-adj p-values
# across all 12 pathogens
#---------------------------
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')

p_fdr <- permute_dist3 %>%
  select(pathogen, p_wash, p_nutr) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen_list)) %>%
  arrange(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(
    p_wash_fdr = p.adjust(p_wash, method = "BH"),
    p_nutr_fdr = p.adjust(p_nutr, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  select(pathogen, p_wash, p_wash_fdr, p_nutr, p_nutr_fdr)

kbl(
  p_fdr,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Permutation p-values and Benjamini-Hochberg corrected p-values, secondary analysis"
)

saveRDS(p_fdr, here("output", "washbb-perm_fdr_pval-12m.rds"))
write_csv(p_fdr, here("output", "washbb-perm_fdr_pval-12m.csv"))
```

# Conditional effects

Per the SAP, test for additive interaction between WSH and Nutrition interventions. If there is no evidence for additive interaction between WSH and Nutrition interventions (P>0.1), our primary analysis will combine arms.

```{r}
#| label: test for interaction
#-------------------------
# include interaction term
# conditional effect
#-------------------------
cond_res_list <- foreach(ii = seq_along(pathogen_list)) %do% {
  di <- d1 %>%
    filter(visit == 2, pathogenf == pathogen_list[ii])

  fiti <- glm(
    seropos ~ wshf * nutrf,
    data = di,
    family = gaussian(link = "identity")
  )

  vcov_cl <- sandwich::vcovCL(fiti, cluster = di$clusterid)
  fiti_rb <- lmtest::coeftest(fiti, vcov = vcov_cl)

  p_int <- fiti_rb["wshfWASH:nutrfNutrition", 4]

  p_df <- data.frame(
    pathogen = pathogen_list[ii],
    p_int = p_int
  )

  if (!is.na(p_int) && p_int < 0.1) {
    print(paste0(pathogen_list[ii], ": Pval = ", round(p_int, 3)))

    musi_i <- emmeans(fiti, ~ wshf + nutrf, vcov = vcov_cl) %>%
      regrid(type = "response")

    contrasts <- contrast(
      musi_i,
      method = list(
        "WASH vs Control" = c(-1, 1, 0, 0),
        "Nutrition vs Control" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),
        "WASH+N vs Control" = c(-1, 0, 0, 1)
      )
    )

    contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contrasts, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
      mutate(pathogen = pathogen_list[ii])

    diffi_i <- pairs(musi_i, simple = "each")

    musi_df <- as.data.frame(musi_i) %>%
      mutate(pathogen = pathogen_list[ii])
    diffi_df <- as.data.frame(diffi_i) %>%
      mutate(pathogen = pathogen_list[ii])

    return(list(
      p_df = p_df,
      musi_df = musi_df,
      diffi_df = diffi_df,
      contrast_df = contrasts_df
    ))
  }

  list(p_df = p_df, musi_df = NULL, diffi_df = NULL, contrast_df = NULL)
}

pvals_df <- bind_rows(lapply(cond_res_list, `[[`, "p_df")) %>%
  mutate(
    p_int = signif(p_int, 3),
    sig = ifelse(p_int < 0.1, "Yes", "No")
  )

sig_musi_df <- bind_rows(lapply(cond_res_list, `[[`, "musi_df")) %>%
  select(pathogen, wshf, nutrf, emmean, SE, min95 = lower.CL, max95 = upper.CL) %>%
  mutate(
    wshf = factor(wshf, levels = c("No WASH", "WASH")),
    nutrf = factor(nutrf, levels = c("No Nutrition", "Nutrition")),
    group = interaction(wshf, nutrf, sep = " + ")
  )

sig_diffi_df <- bind_rows(lapply(cond_res_list, `[[`, "diffi_df")) %>%
  select(nutrf, wshf, pathogen, contrast, estimate, SE, p.value)

sig_contrast_df <- bind_rows(lapply(cond_res_list, `[[`, "contrast_df")) %>%
  select(pathogen, contrast, estimate, SE, p.value, min95 = lower.CL, max95 = upper.CL)

interaction_pathogens <- sig_contrast_df %>%
  distinct(pathogen) %>%
  pull(pathogen) %>%
  as.character()

saveRDS(sig_contrast_df, here("output", "washbb-contrasts-effects-12m.rds"))
write_csv(sig_contrast_df, here("output", "washbb-contrasts-effects-12m.csv"))

saveRDS(sig_diffi_df, here("output", "washbb-conditional-effects-12m.rds"))
write_csv(sig_diffi_df, here("output", "washbb-conditional-effects-12m.csv"))
```

## Table 5. Pairwise contrasts for pathogens with evidence of additive interaction

```{r}
sig_contrast_df %>%
  mutate(est_ci = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", estimate, min95, max95)) %>%
  select(pathogen, contrast, est_ci) %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    col.names = c("Pathogen", "Contrast (vs Control)", "Estimate (95% CI)"),
    caption = "Conditional effects vs Control (risk difference scale) for pathogens with evidence of additive interaction"
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times")

interaction_contrast_plots <- sig_contrast_df %>%
  split(.$pathogen) %>%
  map(~ {
    ggplot(
      .x %>%
        mutate(
          contrast = factor(
            contrast,
            levels = c("WASH vs Control", "Nutrition vs Control", "WASH+N vs Control")
          )
        ),
      aes(x = contrast, y = estimate)
    ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
      geom_point(size = 2, color = cbpal[4]) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = min95, ymax = max95),
        width = 0.15,
        linewidth = 0.8,
        color = cbpal[4]
      ) +
      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = "Risk difference vs Control",
        title = unique(.x$pathogen)
      ) +
      coord_flip() +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "plain")
      )
  })

walk(interaction_contrast_plots, print)
```

# Forest plot for presentation

- For pathogens with evidence of additive interaction, report conditional means and effects in the updated forest plot.
- For FDR in the manuscript dataset, use marginal permutation p-values for pathogens without interaction and interaction-consistent conditional p-values for pathogens with interaction, then adjust those 12 together within each intervention panel.

## Build dataset for manuscript figure/table

```{r}
#--------------------------
# manuscript-ready forest/table
# dataset for the final figure
#--------------------------
format_pct_label <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, paste0(sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x), "%"))
}

format_pp_ci_label <- function(estimate, min95, max95) {
  est_pp <- 100 * estimate
  min_pp <- 100 * min95
  max_pp <- 100 * max95

  est_pp[abs(est_pp) < 0.05] <- 0
  min_pp[abs(min_pp) < 0.05] <- 0
  max_pp[abs(max_pp) < 0.05] <- 0

  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", est_pp, min_pp, max_pp)
}

wash_marginal_panel <- marg_means_v2 %>%
  filter(marginal_mean %in% c("No WASH", "WASH")) %>%
  select(pathogen, marginal_mean, emmean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marginal_mean, values_from = emmean) %>%
  left_join(
    marg_diff_v2 %>%
      filter(contrast == "WASH - No WASH") %>%
      select(pathogen, estimate, min95, max95),
    by = "pathogen"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    p_fdr %>%
      select(pathogen, primary_p = p_wash),
    by = "pathogen"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    pathogen,
    intervention = "WASH",
    effect_source = "marginal",
    p_source = "marginal_permutation",
    interaction_flag = FALSE,
    group0_header = "No WASH",
    group1_header = "WASH",
    group0_mean = `No WASH`,
    group1_mean = WASH,
    estimate,
    min95,
    max95,
    primary_p
  )

wash_conditional_panel <- sig_musi_df %>%
  filter(nutrf == "No Nutrition") %>%
  select(pathogen, wshf, emmean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = wshf, values_from = emmean) %>%
  left_join(
    sig_contrast_df %>%
      filter(contrast == "WASH vs Control") %>%
      select(pathogen, estimate, min95, max95, primary_p = p.value),
    by = "pathogen"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    pathogen,
    intervention = "WASH",
    effect_source = "conditional",
    p_source = "conditional_wash_vs_control_no_nutrition",
    interaction_flag = TRUE,
    group0_header = "No WASH",
    group1_header = "WASH",
    group0_mean = `No WASH`,
    group1_mean = WASH,
    estimate,
    min95,
    max95,
    primary_p
  )

nutrition_marginal_panel <- marg_means_v2 %>%
  filter(marginal_mean %in% c("No Nutrition", "Nutrition")) %>%
  select(pathogen, marginal_mean, emmean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = marginal_mean, values_from = emmean) %>%
  left_join(
    marg_diff_v2 %>%
      filter(contrast == "Nutrition - No Nutrition") %>%
      select(pathogen, estimate, min95, max95),
    by = "pathogen"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    p_fdr %>%
      select(pathogen, primary_p = p_nutr),
    by = "pathogen"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    pathogen,
    intervention = "Nutrition",
    effect_source = "marginal",
    p_source = "marginal_permutation",
    interaction_flag = FALSE,
    group0_header = "No Nutrition",
    group1_header = "Nutrition",
    group0_mean = `No Nutrition`,
    group1_mean = Nutrition,
    estimate,
    min95,
    max95,
    primary_p
  )

nutrition_conditional_panel <- sig_musi_df %>%
  filter(wshf == "No WASH") %>%
  select(pathogen, nutrf, emmean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = nutrf, values_from = emmean) %>%
  left_join(
    sig_contrast_df %>%
      filter(contrast == "Nutrition vs Control") %>%
      select(pathogen, estimate, min95, max95, primary_p = p.value),
    by = "pathogen"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    pathogen,
    intervention = "Nutrition",
    effect_source = "conditional",
    p_source = "conditional_nutrition_vs_control_no_wash",
    interaction_flag = TRUE,
    group0_header = "No Nutrition",
    group1_header = "Nutrition",
    group0_mean = `No Nutrition`,
    group1_mean = Nutrition,
    estimate,
    min95,
    max95,
    primary_p
  )

wash_plot_panel <- bind_rows(
  wash_marginal_panel %>% filter(!pathogen %in% interaction_pathogens),
  wash_conditional_panel
) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen_list)) %>%
  arrange(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(primary_p_fdr = p.adjust(primary_p, method = "BH"))

nutrition_plot_panel <- bind_rows(
  nutrition_marginal_panel %>% filter(!pathogen %in% interaction_pathogens),
  nutrition_conditional_panel
) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = pathogen_list)) %>%
  arrange(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(primary_p_fdr = p.adjust(primary_p, method = "BH"))

forest_table_data_12m <- bind_rows(wash_plot_panel, nutrition_plot_panel) %>%
  mutate(
    pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
    pathogen_display = ifelse(interaction_flag, paste0(pathogen, " *"), pathogen),
    group0_label = format_pct_label(group0_mean),
    group1_label = format_pct_label(group1_mean),
    diff_label = format_pp_ci_label(estimate, min95, max95),
    estimate_pp = 100 * estimate,
    min95_pp = 100 * min95,
    max95_pp = 100 * max95
  ) %>%
  select(
    intervention,
    pathogen,
    pathogen_display,
    interaction_flag,
    effect_source,
    p_source,
    group0_header,
    group1_header,
    group0_mean,
    group0_label,
    group1_mean,
    group1_label,
    estimate,
    min95,
    max95,
    estimate_pp,
    min95_pp,
    max95_pp,
    diff_label,
    primary_p,
    primary_p_fdr
  )

saveRDS(forest_table_data_12m, here("output", "washbb-forest-plot-table-12m.rds"))
write_csv(forest_table_data_12m, here("output", "washbb-forest-plot-table-12m.csv"))
```

## Final figure dataset at 12 months

```{r}
format_p_display <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
    x < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", x)
  )
}

forest_table_data_12m %>%
  mutate(
    effect_source = ifelse(effect_source == "conditional", "Conditional", "Marginal"),
    primary_p_label = format_p_display(primary_p),
    primary_p_fdr_label = format_p_display(primary_p_fdr)
  ) %>%
  select(
    intervention,
    pathogen_display,
    effect_source,
    group0_label,
    group1_label,
    diff_label,
    primary_p_label,
    primary_p_fdr_label
  ) %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    col.names = c(
      "Panel",
      "Pathogen",
      "Effect Source",
      "Control Mean",
      "Intervention Mean",
      "Difference (95% CI)",
      "Primary p-value",
      "FDR p-value"
    ),
    caption = "Final 12-month dataset used for the manuscript forest plot"
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times")
```


## WASH

```{r}
forest_plot_12m <- forest_table_data_12m %>%
  mutate(
    pathogen_display = factor(
      pathogen_display,
      levels = rev(ifelse(
        pathogen_list %in% interaction_pathogens,
        paste0(pathogen_list, " *"),
        pathogen_list
      ))
    )
  )

forest_limit <- max(
  8,
  ceiling(max(abs(c(forest_plot_12m$min95_pp, forest_plot_12m$max95_pp))) / 2) * 2
)
x_text <- forest_limit + 0.8
x_upper <- x_text + 1.6

p_wash <- ggplot(
  data = forest_plot_12m %>% filter(intervention == "WASH"),
  aes(x = pathogen_display, y = estimate_pp)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = min95_pp, ymax = max95_pp),
    width = 0.2,
    color = cbpal_int[2]
  ) +
  geom_point(color = cbpal_int[2], size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = x_text, label = diff_label, fontface = "bold"),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.3,
    family = "Helvetica"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-forest_limit, forest_limit, by = 4),
    limits = c(-forest_limit, x_upper)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Risk Difference, WASH - No WASH",
    x = "",
    caption = "* Evidence for interaction between WASH and Nutrition. Conditional means and effects are reported for pathogens with evidence of additive interaction (WASH vs Control)."
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 60, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

p_wash

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "washbb-rd-forest-plot-wash-12m.jpg"),
  plot = p_wash,
  width = 200,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm"
)
ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "washbb-rd-forest-plot-wash-12m.png"),
  plot = p_wash,
  width = 200,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm"
)
```
